Nicholas, saw Prove launched its unified Identity Platform in April as the trust layer for an agentic world.

A launch that broad usually opens more in-market accounts than the sales team can cover before they cool, and that is where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Prove needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
